channel.title: Food Service Director - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Food Service Director (foodservicedirector.com)

item.title: My Signature Dish: Clam Soup
item.description: Elior Independent School Dining Chef Joshua Mills of Abington Friends School makes a rule-breaking, elegantly East Coast seafood soup that “drives people crazy.”

item.title: UC campuses first on board with Monterey Bay Aquarium's Verified Green shrimp from Vietnam
item.description: The Aquarium's Global Ocean Conservation division's new designation is helping small-scale Vietnamese farms who are raising sustainable shrimp, but are too small to get the traditional eco-certifications, make it onto the menu at the eco-conscious campuses of UC Davis, UC Sant Cruz and UC Merced.

item.title: Boston College's Chef Phyllis Kaplowitz wins gold at NACUFS Northeast competition
item.description: At the National Association of College & University Food Services (NACUFS) Engage: Northeast held at Boston College, one of BC's own rose to the top with catfish and okra, the featured ingredients leading into this summer's competition in N'Awlins.

item.title: Being a ‘big kid at heart’ is the secret to this chef’s fun pre-K storytelling series
item.description: Chef Chris Kotolski of Quest Food Management Services at Hickory Hill Academy introduces kids to new foods through original stories complete with illustrations.

item.title: Savannah Convention Center partners with Sodexo Live! for a new brand of Southern hospitality
item.description: Sense of place is the name of the game for Iron & Oak Hospitality, the collab between Savannah Convention Center and Sodexo Live! as a major expansion and new hotel means more opportunities to show off the city's signature Southern hospitality.

item.title: New workplace eating data finds employees and decision-makers at a crossroads over lunch
item.description: Boston-based food tech platform ezCater released its 2026 Workplace Cafeteria Report, and you might want to have a seat in your desk chair to read some of the more surprising statistics.

item.title: Dear Advice Guy, How do I reverse engineer hot honey?
item.description: In this month's edition, Advice Guy weighs in on the tipping point between the "make or buy" scenario for hot honey and other signature sauces in your wheelhouse.

item.title: Virginia Tech’s Chef Nicholas Simpson wins gold at NACUFS Mid-Atlantic competition
item.description: At the National Association of College & University Food Services (NACUFS) Engage: Mid-Atlantic held at The George Washington University, Simpson won with his German-inspired catfish cutlet and will go on to compete in N’Awlins.

item.title: Recipe report: Pi Day will be extra sweet this year
item.description: Lean into the infinite dessert possibilities on 3.14 this year, then take these new classic pies into the spring and summer. Sweet priority: Don't miss the lemon icebox pie.

item.title: Looking forward to the 2026 Big Ten Chefs Immersion: Get to know the chefs
item.description: The event, put on by FoodService Director, brings together chefs from across the Big Ten schools to network and try out new recipes using products from the event’s sponsors: Custom Culinary, Irresistible Food Group, J.T.M. Food Group, Mountaire Farms, Simplot and 50CUT.
